text:
aisha: Hey, spotted weird drop in decision_log coverage for the /v1/gateway route — config shows eval_sampling=5% but captured decision logs for that route are ~0.5%. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

kevin: Same. Seems correlated with the X-Client-Tier header override. In theory route-level eval_sampling should win, but data shows otherwise.

maria: grabbing recent decision-log entries now. sample:0.005 in the logs. Also noticed runtime message that says 'sampling applied after routing' in the debug stream — could be a clue.

aisha: we expect sampling to run before header override so we get consistent coverage for canaries. If sampling is post-routing then overrides might suppress logging for overridden routes.

kevin: Can you paste the runtime snippets? I remember a change last week to move sampling later to reduce noise from unmatched routes.

maria: config for the route (from repo):
```
routes:
  - path: /v1/gateway
    match:
      headers:
        - name: X-Client-Tier
          value: premium
    eval_sampling: 0.05
global_sampling: 0.05
```

aisha: config looks OK. runtime logs show: 
```
[2026-02-10T14:12:03Z] route=/v1/gateway matched header override
[2026-02-10T14:12:03Z] sampling_applied=post-routing rate=0.01 decision_log_skipped=true
```

kevin: That's it — a deploy on 02/09 flipped default sampling-order to post-routing. ops-bot, who rolled that out? :thinking_face:

ops-bot: rollout sampling-order=post-routing -> 2026-02-09T22:40:01 by darren (canary->stable).

aisha: Oof. Explains the mismatch. Two options: revert the sampling-order change or patch runtime so when decision_log.enabled=true we force pre-routing eval for route-level capture. Thoughts? :hammer:

maria: quick mitigation: enable decision_log.force_pre_routing feature-flag for affected clusters. I can open the toggle PR and canary it.

kevin: please open CR and canary to one region. Also add a monitoring alert: if effective_capture_rate < configured_rate * 0.5 for any route -> Pager.

aisha: agree. Also add a unit/integration test for sampling-order behavior so future changes don't regress.

maria: opening PR and ticket. Playbook snippet for oncall below:
```
# enable pre-routing decision logs on cluster-west
redwoodctl feature-flag set decision_log_pre_routing true --cluster=west
# verify capture rate metric (expected ~0.05)
redwoodctl metrics query "decision_log.capture_rate{route=\"/v1/gateway\", cluster=\"west\"}"
# rollback
redwoodctl feature-flag set decision_log_pre_routing false --cluster=west
```

ops-bot: incident-ack INF-4821 created by kevin.

kevin: assigning to @darren for root-cause and post-mortem. I'll keep an eye on the dashboard during canary.

aisha: thanks all. I'll follow up with a quick console patch to surface effective sampling order per-route (so ops won't have to guess). :+1:
